output.review_comment: The PR introduces undocumented, test-specific logic. The [1,2) ROUND_UP rounding rule exists solely to make test_upload_limit_label pass, as the PR description explicitly acknowledges. This behavior is not mentioned in the docstring and appears to be a workaround for conflicting test specifications rather than a principled solution. Before merging, the team should resolve the underlying conflict (the tests seem to have different expectations about units/rounding) and update the docstring to document any special behavior.
